'''June 2000 Sea Girt tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Sea Girt, NJ on 10 June 2000. [[Michael Dalton]] won it. It is known from Michael Dalton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d874">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-sea-girt-nj-6-10-00-by-mike-daltond874/ sea-girt-nj-6-10-00-by-mike-dalton], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" Dalton, 11 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-sea-girt-nj-6-10-00-by-mike-daltond874/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Sea Girt, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Dalton]]
